prepared: 2026-11-15 (market session), before any run; not to be changed after results
reference: official change lists: RFC 7159 Appendix A (from 4627), RFC 8259 Appendix A (from 7159)

steps.why: JSON text is no longer limited to an object or array (7159 App. A)
steps.quote: A JSON text is a serialized object or array.

steps.why: the eval() safety statement was removed by erratum 3607 (7159 App. A)
steps.quote: A JSON text can be safely passed into JavaScript's eval() function

steps.why: encoding section rewritten as 'String and Character Issues' (7159 App. A)
steps.quote: JSON text SHALL be encoded in Unicode.

steps.why: UTF-8 is required when transmitted over a network (8259 App. A, Section 8.1)
steps.quote: JSON text SHALL be encoded in UTF-8, UTF-16, or UTF-32.
The names within an object SHOULD be unique.
